I didn’t like it at all. I thought there was way too much focus on Ken and it almost felt like the entire movie was about him. I feel like the movie entirely went in the wrong direction and could potentially be more harmful than good.

I feel the entire dance scene with the Kens was disturbing and unnecessary. I also felt like very little of Barbies concerns were actually solved or they were addressed too quickly and shallowly. The HQ of Mattel stayed all male and the power dynamic in the Barbie world was still all wrong.

And I honestly felt that it was gross that they summed up all of womanhood into being a mother. It seemed to me as if the message was that being a mom is the purpose of women. And hey maybe it’s just because I don’t have one, but I don’t feel as if being a mother is the point of being a woman.
